# 1.1 Reject configuration keys with the wrong case

## What landed

- `config: reject keys with the wrong case` — `config.Load` now validates every
  top-level key from `toml.MetaData.Keys()` against the exact spellings `dir`,
  `kinds`, `areas`, instead of relying on `Undecoded`, which misses keys the
  decoder matched case-insensitively. Rejected keys are quoted in the error.
- `TestLoadRejectsCaseVariantKeys` covers `Kinds`, `Dir`, `AREAS`, an unrelated
  `foo`, and acceptance of all three lowercase keys with their values.

## Landmark drift

None. `internal/config/config.go` and `config_test.go` are where the work order
said.

## Deviations from the work order

None. The unknown-key error keeps its existing wording and now names every
rejected key, comma-separated.

## What the next session must know

- `meta.Keys()` includes key groups, so a nested key fails the `len(key) != 1`
  check and its dotted `key.String()` is reported. `Undecoded` is no longer
  used.
- `DESIGN.md` already promises an unknown key is an error and lists the three
  lowercase keys, so no design change was needed.
- Both `scripts/verify` and `go test ./...` were green before the commit.

## Open problems

None.

1.2.handover:
# 1.2 Walk past a directory named like the configuration file

## What landed

- `config: skip directory impostors in root discovery` — `FindRoot` now requires
  `os.Stat` to report a regular file (which follows symlinks) before choosing a
  root; anything else, including a directory named `.benchpress.toml`, is
  skipped and discovery continues upward.
- `TestFindRootSkipsConfigDirectory` covers a real config above an impostor
  directory and `ErrNoRoot` when only the impostor exists.
  `TestFindRootFollowsConfigSymlink` pins the symlink-to-regular-file behavior.

## Landmark drift

None. `internal/config/config.go:63` was still `FindRoot`, and the check was
the `os.Stat` at the former line 69.

## Deviations from the work order

None. `os.Stat` already followed symlinks, so `Mode().IsRegular()` on its result
covers both parts of the goal without `Lstat` or `os.Readlink`.

## What the next session must know

- Non-regular files (FIFOs, devices, sockets) now also fail to mark a root;
  that follows from the "regular file" wording and is not separately tested.
- No DESIGN change: §2's "first directory holding `.benchpress.toml`" already
  implies a file, and no format, command, key, lint rule or package boundary
  changed.
- Both `scripts/verify` and `go test ./...` were green before the commit.

## Open problems

None.
